s.note: for the horror movie marathon on TV
s.how: Pop 120g kernels and toss with 30g melted butter and salt. Boil 100g brown sugar, 50g butter and 2 tbsp golden syrup for 4 minutes and pour over half. Bake that half at 120C for 45 minutes, stirring every 15. Mix both together.

Beat 200g grated sharp cheddar with 250g cream cheese, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tbsp Worcestershire. Shape into a ball and chill an hour. Score lines like a pumpkin, roll in more paprika and push a capsicum stem on top. Serve with crackers.

m.how: Brown 800g beef mince with 1 onion and 2 tbsp chilli powder, add 2 tins tomatoes and 2 tins kidney beans and simmer 90 minutes. Hollow 4 small pumpkins and roast at 200C for 30 minutes. Fill with chilli, sour cream and cheddar.

w.note: with a white mask of whipped cream
w.how: Roast 800g pumpkin, purée and whisk with 3 eggs, 150g brown sugar, 200ml cream and 2 tsp mixed spice. Pour into a blind-baked case of 2 sheets sweet shortcrust and bake at 170C for 50 minutes. Cool and pipe a pale mask in whipped cream.

d.how: Simmer 1.5L cloudy apple juice with 2 cinnamon sticks, 6 cloves and a few strips of orange peel for 15 minutes. Strain and ladle into four mugs while hot. Keep the porch light on.
